claims.text: EpicPxls is a curated portfolio of design resources to ship projects faster

quote.text: With EpicPxls, you can browse, and download from, a library of beautiful templates, fonts, graphics and more to create your own customized site or app.

claims.text: Downloaded designs include free unlimited updates for life

quote.text: Each downloaded design comes with free, unlimited updates for life so you never have to worry about outdated templates.

claims.text: New designs are added daily to the front page

claims.text: Customized fonts can be downloaded and used on websites, mobile and apps

quote.text: EpicPxls has customized fonts that you can download and use on your website, mobile, apps and more.

trials.claim: Downloaded designs include free unlimited updates for life
trials.claimQuote: Each downloaded design comes with free, unlimited updates for life so you never have to worry about outdated templates.
trials.reasoning: A reviewer says 60-80% of the designs date from 2015 and are no longer relevant, which materially conflicts with the promise that updates keep templates from becoming outdated.

exhibits.quote: 60-80% of the designs are back from 2015 and not necessarily relevant anymore in 2020.
exhibits.argument: Old irrelevant designs from 2015 still in the library undermines the promise of free unlimited updates preventing outdated templates.

trials.claim: EpicPxls is a curated portfolio of design resources to ship projects faster
trials.claimQuote: EpicPxls is a carefully curated, online portfolio of design resources that helps you ship projects faster.
trials.reasoning: Two buyers directly confirm saving a week or a lot of time on work, and the single report of some closed external pages does not outweigh that consistent evidence of faster shipping.

exhibits.quote: There are quite a few items that can only be found on external, but already closed pages
exhibits.argument: Listings leading to closed external pages undermines the claim of a curated portfolio that helps ship projects faster.

exhibits.quote: Bought it last night and first download saved me at least a week of work and then some.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the resource helps ship work faster by saving a week of work.

exhibits.quote: I love it, it helps me save a lot of time and have a lot of unique designs in my work
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the portfolio helps save a lot of time on design work.

trials.claim: Users can browse and download templates, fonts, graphics and more to create customized sites or apps
trials.claimQuote: With EpicPxls, you can browse, and download from, a library of beautiful templates, fonts, graphics and more to create your own customized site or app.
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm completing a website from a download and finding graphics, icons, UI, and website and app elements, outweighing one reviewer's licensing complaint.

exhibits.quote: The biggest issue is the licensing — the assets are almost impossible to use in practice.
exhibits.argument: Assets being almost impossible to use in practice undermines the claim users can download them to create customized sites or apps.

exhibits.quote: With my 1st download, I was able to complete a website!
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms downloading assets to complete a customized website.

exhibits.quote: If you need graphics, illustrations, icons, UI, and website & app elements, etc., then this is a good place to look!
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the library offers graphics, icons, UI and website and app elements.

trials.claim: All marketplace designs are curated by the EpicPxls team for quality
trials.claimQuote: The EpicPxls team curates all the designs in the marketplace to ensure you’re getting the best possible quality.
trials.reasoning: Two reviewers describe some graphics as mediocre and designs as only good, not great, which directly conflicts with the claim that all designs are curated for the best possible quality.

exhibits.quote: Graphics in some areas rather mediocre, but ok for the price
exhibits.argument: Mediocre graphics in some areas undermines the claim that all designs are curated to ensure best possible quality.

exhibits.quote: There are some good quality designs (not great, but good).
exhibits.argument: Describing designs as only good not great undermines the claim of curation ensuring best possible quality.

exhibits.quote: With EpicPxls being a dedicated graphic and UX design resource I find the quality to be as good as Adobe Stock for those types of resources.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the design resources are high quality comparable to Adobe Stock.

exhibits.quote: First day I already spent more that what I paid for a lifetime. Quality items!
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the items obtained are quality items.
